# Plan template + worked example + anti-patterns

## Template

```markdown
<!-- generated by masterplan on YYYY-MM-DD -->
# Plan: <title>

**Brief:** docs/briefs/<slug>.md (or one-line goal)
**Verified against repo on:** YYYY-MM-DD @ <commit/branch>

## Current state → Target state
<2–6 lines each. Concrete, path-anchored.>

## Decisions
| # | Decision | Alternatives | Why | Wrong when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Slices
### Slice 1: <name>  (depends on: —)
- Delivers: <observable outcome>
- Files: <real paths, verified>
- Tests: <what gets added>
- Verify now: <command / manual check>
- Rollback: <how to undo>

### Slice 2: <name>  (depends on: 1) …
(Parallelizable: 3 ∥ 4 — conflict: both touch <file>)

## Rollout & checkpoints
<Deploy/merge order; where the user reviews before continuing.>

## Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |

## Definition of done
- [ ] <acceptance criterion> — proven by <command/check>
```

## Worked example (abridged)

Brief: dark mode toggle (see distill's worked example).

```markdown
## Current state
Tailwind + CSS variables (`tailwind.config.ts`), no theme persistence,
no preference storage.

## Target state
`dark` class on <html>, toggled from header + settings, persisted in
localStorage, OS-preference default, no first-paint flash.

## Decisions
| # | Decision | Alternatives | Why | Wrong when |
| - | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | class strategy (`dark:` variant) | media-query strategy | needs manual toggle | we drop manual toggle |
| 2 | localStorage, no server storage | user table column | no auth exists yet | per-user sync lands |

## Slices
### Slice 1: theme foundation (depends on: —)
- Delivers: CSS variables for both palettes; `dark` class strategy wired
- Files: `tailwind.config.ts`, `src/styles/theme.css`
- Tests: none possible — visual
- Verify now: manual class flip in devtools flips palettes
- Rollback: revert commit

### Slice 2: toggle + persistence (depends on: 1)
- Delivers: header toggle, localStorage persistence, OS default
- Files: `src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx` (new), `src/app/layout.tsx`,
  `src/components/Header.tsx`
- Tests: unit test for preference read/write/subscribe
- Verify now: toggle → reload → persists; clear storage → OS default
- Rollback: revert commit (no data migration involved)

### Slice 3: flash-free first paint (depends on: 2)
- Delivers: inline pre-hydration script sets class before paint
- Files: `src/app/layout.tsx`
- Tests: e2e — reload with dark pref → no light flash (throttled paint check)
- Verify now: hard reload in dark mode × 10, zero flashes
- Rollback: revert commit

## Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Third-party components ignore variables | medium | audit in slice 1, fallback CSS |

## Definition of done
- [ ] Toggle persists across reload — proven by unit + manual check
- [ ] No wrong-theme flash — proven by e2e in slice 3
- [ ] `npm run build` && `npm test` green
```

Three slices, each independently verifiable. Note there is no "step 9:
add useState" nonsense.

## Anti-patterns

1. **The 70-microstep plan** — "create folder / create file / add import /
   run build" × 20. Means slicing failed; merge into real slices.
2. **Speculative paths** — `src/utils/helpers.ts` that was never opened.
   Plan says "confirm location in slice N" instead.
3. **Horizontal slicing** — "slice 1: all the API, slice 2: all the UI"
   → nothing is verifiable until the end. Cut vertically.
4. **Rollback = "trust me"** — every destructive step names its undo.
5. **The plan that restates the brief** — reference it, don't copy it.
6. **Decision-free plans** — every "should we X or Y" left open means the
   implementer (a weaker model, maybe) decides by accident later.
